meta.title: PLSQL Studio
meta.description: PLSQL Studio converts Oracle and MySQL functions, procedures, packages, views, triggers, tables and queries to HGDB V9 syntax. Tabs switch between Overview, Task center, Task detail, and Connections, with dark/light themes. Overview shows the conversion pipeline and trends; Task center tracks fetch/convert/execute progress per task; Task detail provides source-to-target editors and conversion results; Connections manages source (Oracle / MySQL) and target (HGDB-V9-PostgreSQL / HGDB-V9-Oracle / HGDB-V9-MySQL) profiles.
